legal_ref: Zakon o davku na dodano vrednost (ZDDV-1), 41. člen; rate first set from 1 July 2013 by ZIPRS1314-A, 10. člen (new 60.a člen ZIPRS1314), Uradni list RS 46/2013
quote: FURS: "V skladu s slovensko DDV zakonodajo se DDV za dobave blaga ali storitev obračunava in plačuje po splošni stopnji 22 %, razen za dobave blaga in storitev, za katere je določena nižja stopnja 9,5 %." ZIPRS1314-A, 60.a člen (1): "Ne glede na prvi odstavek 41. člena ... ZDDV-1 se, od vključno 1. julija 2013 dalje, davek na dodano vrednost ... obračunava in plačuje po splošni stopnji 22 % od davčne osnove" — VAT is charged at the general rate of 22% (reduced rate 9.5%); from 1 July 2013 inclusive the general rate is 22%.
source_title: Finančna uprava RS (FURS) – Davek na dodano vrednost (DDV); start date from Uradni list RS 46/2013 (ZIPRS1314-A) https://www.uradni-list.si/_pdf/2013/Ur/u2013046.pdf

reduced_rates.scope: Annex I ZDDV-1: foodstuffs, water supply, medicines and medical aids, passenger transport, accommodation, restaurant food, cultural and sports admissions, social housing, hairdressing, minor repairs, agricultural inputs, and other listed items
Annex IV ZDDV-1 (special reduced rate): books, newspapers and periodicals incl. electronic

notes: The rate was 20% before 1 July 2013; ZIPRS1314-A raised it to 22% and the reduced rate from 8.5% to 9.5% from that date. The 5% special rate (books, newspapers, e-publications) dates from 2020. Exports and intra-EU supplies exempt with right of deduction. TEDB (2026-07-01) shows 22% / 9.5% / 5%, consistent.
unverified: The current text of ZDDV-1 art. 41 on PISRS could not be read: the site needs a JavaScript proof-of-work check, which was not bypassed. The current rate is confirmed by the FURS page and TEDB instead
Whether art. 41 itself was later amended to state 22% (rather than relying on the ZIPRS1314-A override) was not checked; the rate has been 22% continuously since 1 July 2013
